title: Missing campaign ownership check in zone bulk linking
vulnerabilityInformation: A missing campaign ownership check was identified in the bulk-linking operation of a zone management file. The single-link operation and XML-RPC API were also affected by this issue. An authorized user with zone-linking permissions could associate another agency's campaign with their own zone. The unauthorized association could expose the foreign campaign's name, type and identifier in the linked-campaign listing. Campaign ownership validation was added to the bulk-linking and single-link operations and in the XML-RPC campaign-linking method to resolve this issue.
